findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation only drops diagnostics whose location is in source of another compilation. Diagnostics with no location (Location.None, from FirstOrDefault() null) pass the filter (IsInSource is false). Diagnostics for metadata-only closed generic structs (MsgPack004 MemberNeedsKey, MsgPack003 etc.) are therefore still reported with no location in users' builds, so a defining assembly's non-annotated members could surface as new location-less errors/warnings in the consuming project. MsgPack004 is an Error (L2), so a previously silent build (generator crashed) may now fail. The filter condition is inverted relative to its doc comment.

Assert no MsgPack004/MsgPack003 diagnostics are reported in app. Expect failure due to Location.None diagnostics passing the filter.

findings.claim: The wrapper only affects the analyzer callback path. If any remain, the IndexOutOfRange still fires for closed generic structs. Also, the generator path passes null reportDiagnostic, so the guard does nothing there. The requirement's CS8785 fix depends on the remaining sites being safe.
